name: brief
title_zh: 短片企划书：前提、类型、调性、主角、冲突
tagline_zh: 脑子里只有「一个女孩在便利店等雨停」，它能补出类型、基调、主角欲望、核心冲突和片长，让你第二天就敢约人拍。
tagline_en: You have only "a girl waiting out the rain in a convenience store" — it fills in genre, tone, want, conflict and.
desc_en: Turn one sentence into a brief a film can be built from — premise, genre, tone, protagonist, conflict, length.
why_zh: 它不写剧情，只钉死开拍前必须定下的那几格，逼你在动笔前先想清楚冲突是什么。
why_en: It doesn't write the story — it nails down the few decisions you must make before shooting, forcing you to know the conflict.
limit_zh: 只产出企划书，不写分镜、台词和场景表；给的是单条短片规格，长片或剧集它撑不住；你那一句话太抽象（比如「关于孤独」）时。
limit_en: Brief only — no shot list, dialogue or scene breakdown. Built for one short film; features and series are out of scope. Vague input like "about.
title_en: A shootable short-film brief: premise, genre, tone, lead.
